latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release: Monitors 20+ premium news RSS feeds and matches breaking stories to Polymarket markets.
- Uses fast pre-filtering to reject noise and prioritize high-signal breaking news.
- Analyzes story impact and generates trade signals when estimated price impact exceeds 12%.
- Supports dry-run mode by default; enable real trading with --live flag.
- Includes configurable news sources, impact scoring system, and remixable template for customization.
